guide: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art NPC sprite sheet for a professional educational Phaser game for 7–8 year old children in Peru. A friendly female community survey guide with brown skin, dark braided hair, turquoise vest, cream shirt, dark blue trousers, simple shoes, holding a wooden clipboard and a small blank round voting token. Exactly four evenly spaced frames in ONE horizontal row, same full body scale and feet baseline, facing slightly right front three-quarter view. Frame1 idle holding clipboard; frame2 raises hand to greet; frame3 indicates clipboard; frame4 hand relaxes. Clear actual pose changes, consistent face and clothing, crisp polished pixel clusters, warm light from upper left, dark teal outlines, warm terracotta highlights, no blur, no letters, no numerals, no UI, no other characters. Each frame fits completely inside its own equal cell, ample transparent gutters, real transparent background. Wide 3:1 composition. Suitable on a softly painted pixel-art Peruvian market plaza. Do not draw contact sheets or frame borders.
booth: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated production game prop for a polished pixel-art educational market game for children aged 7-8 in Peru. A small welcoming community survey booth, front view slightly top down, wooden desk with sturdy legs, turquoise and cream canvas awning, warm golden wooden trim, a few blank round voting tokens neatly stacked on the desk, blank small hanging wooden sign, open clear central space. Crisp detailed pixel art with readable large forms, deep teal outline, cream/turquoise/terracotta palette, warm light from upper left, soft shadow. Genuine transparent background, full prop uncropped, no ground scenery, no people, no lettering, no numbers, no graphs painted into the prop. Wide composition. The booth will be rendered behind an animated community guide, math and localized labels overlaid by Phaser.
